_modification_description: Changed the earnings_summary to describe a revenue beat, while key_metrics shows revenue of $634M which correctly beats estimates. However, the guidance_next_quarter is changed from the actual strong guide ($837M-$841M for FY2024) to a weaker '$611M-$623M for Q2, maintaining full-year guidance at $2.58B-$2.62B' — which was actually from the prior quarter. This creates a subtle guidance misrepresentation.

input_data.earnings_summary: Palantir reported Q1 2024 results that beat expectations across key metrics. Revenue reached $634 million, up 21% year-over-year — the company's fastest growth rate since 2022. U.S. commercial revenue surged 40% YoY to $150 million, with U.S. commercial customer count growing 69% to 262 customers. U.S. government revenue grew 12% to $257 million. Adjusted operating income came in at $209 million (33% margin). EPS (non-GAAP) of $0.08 per share beat the $0.08 consensus. CEO Alex Karp credited AI Platform (AIP) bootcamp model as a breakthrough go-to-market strategy driving unprecedented U.S. commercial adoption velocity. The stock-based compensation expense remains elevated at $127 million for the quarter.

key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Q2 2024: $611M-$623M; Full-year 2024: $2.58B-$2.62B — MISINFORMATION: Actual Q2 guide was $649M-$653M and FY2024 guide raised to $2.68B-$2.69B.

input_data.macro_context: U.S. government AI adoption accelerating across defense and intelligence agencies, benefiting Palantir's government segment. Enterprise AI spending on analytics and decision-support platforms growing rapidly. Competition from Microsoft's Azure AI services, Databricks, and Snowflake intensifying in the commercial AI analytics market. Stock-based compensation concerns among institutional investors remain a valuation overhang.

key_risk_factors: Stock-based compensation at 20% of revenue remains high and dilutes shareholder returns
International revenue growth decelerating while U.S. drives all the momentum
U.S. commercial customer count (262) growing fast but average contract size still small
Government contract renewal risk as budget priorities shift with election cycle
Valuation at 75x sales historically vulnerable to growth deceleration
missed_signals: AIP bootcamp model was converting Fortune 500 companies from trial to deployment in 30-60 days — unprecedented velocity
Rule-of-40 score of 54% was the highest in company history, signaling improving growth-efficiency balance
